title: OHLCVBar
description: Closed OHLCV candle. Bar open time is UTC-aligned for the timeframe. Optional buy_volume / sell_volume accumulate classified aggressor volume (explicit aggressor or derived vs mid). Consumers compute delta = buy_volume - sell_volume; no delta field is published. When both are set, buy_volume + sell_volume should approximately equal volume.

buy_volume.description: Sum of volume classified as buy aggressor. Null if no tick on the bar could be classified.

sell_volume.description: Sum of volume classified as sell aggressor. Consumers: delta = buy_volume - sell_volume.
